_doc: Empirical nav-panel coordinate map (operator-measured, Claude-verified 2026-06-14). Filtered-to-systems view, Sol. Replaces offset-guessing — see resume-state-2026-06-14-navpanel-cv memory.
verification: orange_frac 0.26-0.34 + template corr 0.60-0.97 vs mean system glyph + visual box overlay (2_verified/3_verified). Selected rows: inverted polarity (orange_frac ~0.7, corr ~ -0.75).

geometry.x_drift_note: icon X increases going DOWN (perspective tilt); right edge of panel is farther/lower

selected_row.tell: inverted polarity — dark glyph on bright-orange highlight band

column_1.meaning: leftmost body/system TYPE icon (here: system glyph = concentric circles). This is the column whose X varies with orbital indentation in body views; in a systems-only view all rows are systems so it is uniform.

coordinate_model_v1.validated: 2026-06-14, operator-confirmed 'WAY better, on point' on 4.png (Sol body view, top-bounded)
coordinate_model_v1.formula: x0 = indent_base_x_left[col] + tilt_x_per_row_px*(row-1) ;  yc = icon_center_y_row1 + row_pitch_px*(row-1)
coordinate_model_v1.cap_note: Nav panel indents MAX 3 levels = 4 columns (Gemini-confirmed + TYC-observed). Do NOT expect 5-7. Column meaning: col1=primary star(s); col2=planets / secondary stars; col3=moons; col4(MAX)=sub-moons OR man-made (station/outpost/megaship/settlement). Barycenters = SAME level (no extra indent). USS/RES/CombatZone/fleet-carriers are anchored to the nearest body and do NOT force col4.
coordinate_model_v1.col4_note: 575 = extrapolated from the ~15.5 step; the one col4 row in TYC image-cache/8.png was the SELECTED (inverted) row so not directly measured. Validate against a non-selected col4 row.
coordinate_model_v1.cross_system_validated: TYC 3319-306-1 (deep, unexplored) tilt-adjusted icon X = col2 ~544, col3 ~559 — IDENTICAL to Sol. Model is SYSTEM-INDEPENDENT (fixed cockpit HUD geometry).
coordinate_model_v1.known_drift: rows 8+ ~1px low+right; row 11 a couple px low. Linear model slightly oversteps toward the bottom (perspective foreshortening) — refine with a DEEPER system (more rows) via a homography / non-linear pitch.
coordinate_model_v1.depth_source_decision: PRIMARY = method A: detect icon left-edge X, tilt-correct, snap to the indent grid. FALLBACK = journal body parent-chain (BodyID->depth), run AGGRESSIVELY in the background so the player is never left with nothing (operator directive 2026-06-14).
coordinate_model_v1.selected_row: inverted-polarity icon (orange_frac ~0.7, template corr negative) — handle separately.

column_0: TODO — operator to provide (column left of the type-icon: status/filter column).
next: capture a DEEPER-nesting system (5-6 indent columns) to extend indent_base_x + fix bottom drift; then map column 0; then per-type icon templates; build the detect+snap localizer with journal-parent-chain fallback.
